about: The behavioural knobs of this harness, as data: a method edits a value here instead of
rewriting the launcher, so the diff says which knob moved and the record can name it.
Defaults live in agent.py; a missing file or a dropped key falls back to them, so this
file is an overlay on the code rather than a second source of truth.
